parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description:
The real-time log type. Valid values:

- **dcdn_log_er_pod**: edge container logs.
- **dcdn_log_dns**: edge DNS logs.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description:
The data center. Valid values:
- **cn**: the Chinese mainland.
- **sg**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

parameters.name: DeliveryType
parameters.description:
The delivery type. Valid values:

- **sls**: Alibaba Cloud Simple Log Service.
- **http**: HTTP service.
- **aws3**: Amazon S3 service.
- **oss**: Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service.
- **kafka**: Kafka service.
- **aws3cmpt**: Amazon S3-compatible service.

parameters.name: Details
parameters.description: The list of Edge Routine (ER) pods to configure.

parameters.name: FieldName
parameters.description: The fields to deliver, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: FilterVer
parameters.description:
The version of the filter rule.

> This parameter is used for backward compatibility with legacy filter rules. The default value is v1. New tasks use v2.

parameters.name: S3Delivery
parameters.description: The S3 or S3-compatible delivery configuration parameters.
